evidence.quote: This report outlines the intended designs and procedures involved

criteria.reasoning: Clear headings and readable writing, but figures lack numbers/titles, tables poorly formatted, Wikipedia used despite ban, referencing inconsistent.

technical_issues.issue: RAAN 27.33 deg claimed to indicate launch facility location; RAAN is orbit plane orientation, not site, and will not equal site longitude.
Circular orbit described with Argument of Latitude as static element; u varies rapidly and LTAN/local time not specified for SSO.
Baseline Vega E in 2025 was unflown/developmental; reliance on future SSMS replication adds schedule risk, acknowledged but weakly mitigated.
Wikipedia cited for launch manifest despite explicit ban; reference list is bare URLs without proper citation style.

overall: Good reef-monitoring SSO concept with credible STK support, but weakened by orbit detail errors, unproven launcher baseline and presentation/referencing flaws.
